data.name: Highlights of Boston - Public Walking Tour (Spanish)
data.description:
Languages available: English, Spanish, Turkish

The Highlights of Boston Public Walking Tour is a 2.5-hour guided tour that takes visitors on an immersive journey through some of Boston's most iconic landmarks. The tour begins at the stunning Ether Monument (Boston Public Garden), where visitors will see some of the city's most significant buildings and monuments, including the Trinity Church and the Boston Public Library. Other stops on the tour include the Granary Burial Ground, Boston Common, Faneuil Hall and the Paul Revere House.

This tour is an excellent way for visitors to experience the best of Boston's history and culture. The knowledgeable and multilingual tour guides will provide fascinating insights into the city's rich heritage, from the colonial era to the present day. Additionally, the tour is entirely on foot, allowing visitors to get up close and personal with the city's landmarks and neighborhoods. Whether you're a history buff, an architecture enthusiast, or simply looking for a fun and educational way to spend a day in Boston, the Highlights of Boston - Public Walking Tour is a must-have experience.
data.cancellation_notes:
Cancellation of a reservation must be made at least 72 hours prior to tour to qualify for a full refund. 
50% refund between 48-72 hours. No refunds will be issued within 48 hours of a tour. 

Full refund if you cancel anytime due to certain unforeseeable events: These include travel restrictions imposed by governments, war, civil insurrection, strike, extreme weather, earthquake or natural disaster; circumstances where a cruise ship cannot dock, or flight to your destination is cancelled. Please note this does not include personal or family illness or injury, poor weather or a change of plans.
